dialogues.jp:
｛わず／僅｝かに開けた窓から吹き込む風に、カーテンが
そよいでいる。
dialogues.en: It was terrible...
dialogues.text: It was terrible...

dialogues.jp:
もはや俺の定位置となった窓辺に寄りかかり、
いつものように演奏に耳を傾ける。
dialogues.en: After explaining to them many times, I was finally released.
dialogues.text: After explaining to them many times, I was finally released.

dialogues.jp: 春を感じさせる風は柔らかく心地よい……。
dialogues.en: "Fuck, Suginami......"
dialogues.text: "Fuck, Suginami......"

dialogues.en: I'll get him back for this...
dialogues.text: I'll get him back for this...

dialogues.jp: グーっ……。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、寝るな！」

眞子の怒声が俺の鼓膜を直撃し、片足を踏み込
んだ夢の世界から強引に引き戻す。
dialogues.en:
I walk upstairs with heavy feet and stand in front of the
music room.
dialogues.text:
I walk upstairs with heavy feet and stand in front of the
music room.

dialogues.jp:
目を開けば、フルートを持って仁王立ちしてい
る眞子がいた。
dialogues.en: It's noon already...
dialogues.text: It's noon already...

dialogues.jp:
さぞかし鬼のような形相かと思いきや、どこか
子供のような｛す／拗｝ねた顔だ。
dialogues.en: They wasted lots of my time.
dialogues.text: They wasted lots of my time.

dialogues.jp: 眞子の右手が真っ赤に燃える。
dialogues.en: (I wonder if Mako is here.)
dialogues.text: (I wonder if Mako is here.)

dialogues.jp:
その様子を見ていた音楽部の部長が、くすくす
笑いながら声をかける。
dialogues.en:
Curling my fingers around the doorknob of the music room, I
pause a moment and tighten my grip.
dialogues.text:
Curling my fingers around the doorknob of the music room, I
pause a moment and tighten my grip.

dialogues.jp: 部長の冷やかしで、眞子が頬を紅潮させる。
dialogues.en: (She is here......)
dialogues.text: (She is here......)

dialogues.jp:
しかし眞子のやつ、カップルに見せるために顔
まで赤くするとは演技派だよな。
dialogues.en:
Mako's here, sitting in a circle of her friends with a
rather dark expression. She's just listening to them
talking.
dialogues.text:
Mako's here, sitting in a circle of her friends with a
rather dark expression. She's just listening to them
talking.

dialogues.jp:
持ち場に戻りつつ、眞子が、ちらりとこちらを
振り返った。
dialogues.en:
At the door, I greet the club members who I've come to
recognize, and I walk into the room just like I have been
doing.
dialogues.text:
At the door, I greet the club members who I've come to
recognize, and I walk into the room just like I have been
doing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「もう寝ないでよ」
顔を輝かせて眞子が練習に戻る。
dialogues.en: She gives a startled cry, looking astonished.
dialogues.text: She gives a startled cry, looking astonished.

dialogues.jp: （しかし……）
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.jp: フルートを吹く眞子をぼーっと見つめる。
dialogues.en:
I give her a brief greeting and walk toward the window, my
reserved spot.
dialogues.text:
I give her a brief greeting and walk toward the window, my
reserved spot.

dialogues.jp:
（フルートを吹いてる時は、とてもいい顔をす
　るな）
dialogues.en:
I stand with my back to the window and lean against it, and
I realize Mako's standing in front of me.
dialogues.text:
I stand with my back to the window and lean against it, and
I realize Mako's standing in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Hi, you came."
dialogues.text: "Hi, you came."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が少し目を開けて俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Mako's smiling as she talks to me, but she looks disturbed.
dialogues.text: Mako's smiling as she talks to me, but she looks disturbed.

dialogues.jp: （やれやれ、疑い深いやつだ）
dialogues.en: "Nemu sent me up."
dialogues.text: "Nemu sent me up."

dialogues.jp: 俺はまだ起きてるぞ〜
dialogues.en: I'm not gonna say 'I came here to see how you're doing'.
dialogues.text: I'm not gonna say 'I came here to see how you're doing'.

dialogues.jp:
まるで授業参観の父親のように、ひらひらと手
を振ってみせる。集中しろ馬鹿者め。
dialogues.en: "Because it's so late... I thought you weren't coming."
dialogues.text: "Because it's so late... I thought you weren't coming."

dialogues.jp: （ふふっ、いいことを思いついたぞ……）
dialogues.en: "Actually I came in the morning."
dialogues.text: "Actually I came in the morning."

dialogues.jp: ちょっとした悪戯心が芽生え、にやりと笑う。
dialogues.en: "Then why did you arrive here this late?"
dialogues.text: "Then why did you arrive here this late?"

dialogues.jp: （くくく、これでもくらいやがれ！）
dialogues.en: Tell me about it.
dialogues.text: Tell me about it.

dialogues.jp: 眞子の笑いを取るべくウインクしてみせる。
dialogues.en: "I got into trouble."
dialogues.text: "I got into trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What!? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What!? What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の顔が一瞬にして赤く染まる。
dialogues.en: Unexpectedly, she is worried about me.
dialogues.text: Unexpectedly, she is worried about me.

dialogues.jp:
ヒット確認後、さらに投げキッスのコンボに
繋げる。
dialogues.en:
"I got framed by several members of the planning committee,
and I was talking to them for quite a while. I guess a
police interview may be similar to what I've just
experienced."
dialogues.text:
"I got framed by several members of the planning committee,
and I was talking to them for quite a while. I guess a
police interview may be similar to what I've just
experienced."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が真っ赤のまま、俺から目をそらした。
dialogues.en: Mako looks like she has no idea what I'm talking about.
dialogues.text: Mako looks like she has no idea what I'm talking about.

dialogues.jp:
俺のコンボを食らいながらもフルートの演奏を
乱さなかったのは、さすがと言えるだろう。
dialogues.en: "Anyway, are you on a break now?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, are you on a break now?"

dialogues.jp: （む、それならば……）
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は眞子に向かって口パクでメッセージを送る。
dialogues.en: I look all round. Everyone's got a drink.
dialogues.text: I look all round. Everyone's got a drink.

dialogues.jp:
眞子は演奏を続けながらも、口パクの内容が気
になるのか、俺の方をちらちらとうかがってい
る。
dialogues.en: "Where's my drink?"
dialogues.text: "Where's my drink?"

dialogues.jp: （ア・イ・シ・テ・ル）
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Ah, sorry. There is none for you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, sorry. There is none for you."

dialogues.jp:
上手く伝わってないのか、眞子は首をかしげな
がら、俺の方を覗き込むように見る。
dialogues.en: "What, nothing left?"
dialogues.text: "What, nothing left?"

dialogues.jp: ――だから、もう一度、
dialogues.en:
I'm so thirsty, because I had to spend so long explaining to
those planning committee members to clear myself.
dialogues.text:
I'm so thirsty, because I had to spend so long explaining to
those planning committee members to clear myself.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en:
"We normally buy enough for people who are here, and you
said you weren't coming back here anymore."
dialogues.text:
"We normally buy enough for people who are here, and you
said you weren't coming back here anymore."

dialogues.jp:
言葉が伝わった瞬間、眞子の顔が耳から煙を噴
き出しそうな勢いで真っ赤に染まった。
dialogues.en: You're right, though.
dialogues.text: You're right, though.

dialogues.jp: そして、フルートの演奏が止まる。

dialogues.speaker: Manager
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、どうしたのよ眞子？　まだ演奏の
　途中よ」
dialogues.en: "Gather up, everyone. We're gonna start."
dialogues.text: "Gather up, everyone. We're gonna start."

dialogues.jp:
部長が心配そうに声をかけるが、その声は眞子
の耳にはまったく届いていないようだった。
dialogues.en:
At the manager's voice, the club members scattered
throughout the room are returning to their spots with their
musical instruments.
dialogues.text:
At the manager's voice, the club members scattered
throughout the room are returning to their spots with their
musical instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I have to go now."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I have to go now."

dialogues.jp:
眞子は無言のまま、するすると間合いを詰めて
くる。
dialogues.en: Picking up her flute, Mako takes a few steps.
dialogues.text: Picking up her flute, Mako takes a few steps.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura... You can have this."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura... You can have this."

dialogues.jp:
眞子が身体を預けてくる。前回のように慌てる
ことなく、そっと腰に手を回して抱きとめる。
dialogues.en:
Mako stretches out her hand toward me. And I find an oasis
of life in her hand ----
dialogues.text:
Mako stretches out her hand toward me. And I find an oasis
of life in her hand ----

dialogues.jp: （あれ？）
dialogues.en: "Wow! Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Wow! Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……どういうつもりなのよ、まったくもう」
dialogues.en:
"That's OK. ...I only gave it to you because I can't keep it
while playing."
dialogues.text:
"That's OK. ...I only gave it to you because I can't keep it
while playing."

dialogues.jp: なんだか泣き出しそうな顔で｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en:
Turning her back as if to hide her face from me, Mako walks
towards the group.
dialogues.text:
Turning her back as if to hide her face from me, Mako walks
towards the group.

dialogues.jp:
止まるはずの眞子の顔が止まらず、ふたりの唇
が重なる。
dialogues.en: Why does she have to be shy?
dialogues.text: Why does she have to be shy?

dialogues.jp:
眞子の柔らかな唇を感じながら、頭の中で疑問
符が跳ね回る。
（えっ、あれ、フリじゃないぞ、これ？）
dialogues.en:
Looking at Mako, who's taking her spot, I drink up the rest
of the juice.
dialogues.text:
Looking at Mako, who's taking her spot, I drink up the rest
of the juice.

dialogues.jp:
分からないことだらけだが、確かなのは、柔ら
かな唇と、ぎゅっと｛つむ／瞑｝った目からこぼれそうな
涙と、震える華奢な身体。

無意識のうちに腰に回した手に力を入れて、眞
子の華奢な身体を強く抱き締める。

dialogues.speaker: Schoolgirl
dialogues.en: "Good. Mako's herself again."
dialogues.text: "Good. Mako's herself again."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が息継ぎをするように唇を離す。
dialogues.en: "Yes. She couldn't concentrate this morning."
dialogues.text: "Yes. She couldn't concentrate this morning."

dialogues.jp: 「あ、悪い、苦しかったか？」
眞子が目を開けて、涙を｛にじ／滲｝ませたまま｛ほほえ／微笑｝む。
dialogues.en: (That's unusual.)
dialogues.text: (That's unusual.)

dialogues.jp:
眞子の顔がゆっくりと離れていく。俺も腰に回
した手を離して、眞子の身体を解放する。
dialogues.en:
I can't believe that Mako could make poor work of her
performance.
dialogues.text:
I can't believe that Mako could make poor work of her
performance.

dialogues.en: "Maybe I'm right."
dialogues.text: "Maybe I'm right."

dialogues.en: I catch the eye of the girl who's talking.
dialogues.text: I catch the eye of the girl who's talking.

dialogues.jp:
気がつけば、周りは水を打ったように静かで、
全員が｛あぜん／唖然｝とした表情で俺たちに注目している。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, maybe."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, maybe."

dialogues.jp: 眞子がくるりと振り返り、部長に向き直った。
dialogues.en: Others are also staring at me.
dialogues.text: Others are also staring at me.

dialogues.jp:
少しいたずらっぽい表情で、部長さんが許可す
る。
眞子が再度俺に向き直る。
dialogues.en: (What's up?)
dialogues.text: (What's up?)

dialogues.jp: 眞子が首を傾げ、俺の顔を覗きこむ。
dialogues.en: What did I do?
dialogues.text: What did I do?

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだよ……」

眞子がじっと俺を見つめる。期待と不安の入り
混じった切ない目だ。
dialogues.en:
Looking toward the middle of the room, I see Mako playing
the flute.
dialogues.text:
Looking toward the middle of the room, I see Mako playing
the flute.

dialogues.jp: （分かったよ。まったく、かったるいな…）
dialogues.en: No problem.
dialogues.text: No problem.

dialogues.jp:
内心でため息をつきながらも、少しだけ鼓動が
早まる。
dialogues.en: Listening to their performance, I close my eyes.
dialogues.text: Listening to their performance, I close my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「……それじゃあ、明日はデートと洒落込むか」
◆眞子の調子◆
デートの約束をした。
dialogues.en: "Grrrrr......"
dialogues.text: "Grrrrr......"
